caption: The image shows a rectangular stone relief with a border decorated with carved swirling patterns and leaf motifs, primarily along the left and upper edges. Within the central area of the relief, there are three human figures depicted in profile. The figure on the left is wearing what appears to be a helmet and armor, holding a weapon raised in one hand and gripping the shoulder of the central figure with the other. The central figure, which is smaller and more slender, stands with one arm raised and the other arm down, facing left toward the armored figure. The figure on the right is also wearing what appears to be a helmet and armor, facing left, and holding an object in one hand with the other arm bent. At the bottom of the relief, there is an inscribed panel that contains a row of uppercase letters and symbols carved into the stone, forming a block of text. The overall color of the artifact is a uniform gray, typical of carved stone, with shadows emphasizing the depth of the relief and the cracks visible near the lower central area. There is a missing or broken portion on the upper right corner of the artifact. The image is monochromatic, and the relief is centered on a plain background.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
